description: Pure library module per Appendix B. Provides URL-path and hostname-pattern indicators for shadow MCP detection: '/mcp', '/mcp/sse', 'mcp.*' subdomains, known MCP server hostnames (mcp.stripe.com, mcp.cloudflare.com). Pure function, no I/O. Complements mcp_traffic_fingerprints (body scanning) with URL/hostname scanning. Attribution in docstring: 'Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com, 2026-04-14.' No daemons. No network. No DB. Must include if __name__ == '__main__' self-smoke exercising detection against ≥3 known inputs.
